entities.name: Dragoș Pîslaru
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dragoș Nicolae Pîslaru is a Romanian economist and politician of REPER who served as a Member of the European Parliament between 2019 and 2024. He was previously a member of USR PLUS/USR. He also held the position of Minister of Labor, Family, Social Protection and the Elderly in the government of Prime Minister Dacian Cioloș from 18 April 2016, until 4 January 2017.

entities.summary: Dragoș Nicolae Pîslaru is a Romanian economist and politician of REPER who served as a Member of the European Parliament between 2019 and 2024. He was previously a member of USR PLUS/USR. He also held the position of Minister of Labor, Family, Social Protection and the Elderly in the government of Prime Minister Dacian Cioloș from 18 April 2016, until 4 January 2017.
